Imaging & technology

A clearer picture.
A considered plan.

Explore panoramic dental X-rays and 3D CBCT imaging at Wilton Dental Practice.

Panoramic imaging

Digital OPG X-rays

A panoramic image provides a broad view of the teeth and jaws. Your referring clinician can explain why an examination is needed.

Three-dimensional imaging

3D CBCT scans

CBCT imaging can support assessment and planning where a three-dimensional view is clinically appropriate.

For patients and referring dentists

Contact the practice to discuss the required scan, referral details and appointment availability. Ask how images will be shared with your treating clinician and whether a separate report is needed.

  1. Confirm the scan requested and the clinical referral information.
  2. Arrange an appointment and confirm the fee and preparation instructions.
  3. Agree how the images and any required report will be delivered.
